public_rationale: OpenAI's own researcher described contact with one organizer before announcing the result. He separately acknowledged an earlier invitation that OpenAI declined. Together, these accounts support Marcus's ordinary claim of limited communication. They do not support a stronger claim of no contact.
limitations: The conclusion relies on participant accounts rather than a complete correspondence record.
This verdict does not decide the separate dispute about announcement timing or an embargo.
